{{short description|Austrian mathematician}}
'''Monika Ludwig''' (born 1966 in [[Cologne]])<ref>[http://www.frauenspuren.at/frauenspuren_heute/professorinnen/monika_ludwig/ Interview with Ludwig], TU Vienna, 2012, retrieved 2013-02-07.</ref> is an Austrian mathematician, University Professor of Convex and Discrete Geometry at the [[Vienna University of Technology]].<ref name="profile">[http://dmg.tuwien.ac.at/ludwig/ Faculty profile], Vienna University of Technology, retrieved 2013-02-07.</ref>

==Academic career==
Ludwig earned a Dipl.-Ing. degree from the Vienna University of Technology in 1990, and a doctorate in 1994 under the supervision of [[Peter M. Gruber]].<ref name="profile"/><ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=64917}}</ref> She remained at the same university as an assistant and associate professor from 1994 until 2007, when she moved to the [[Polytechnic Institute of New York University]]. She returned to the Vienna University of Technology as a full professor in 2010.<ref name="profile"/>

==Awards and honors==
Ludwig won the Edmund and Rosa Hlawka Prize of the [[Austrian Academy of Sciences]], given to an outstanding Austrian researcher in [[geometry of numbers]] or [[numerical analysis]] under the age of 30, in 1998.<ref>[http://stipendien.oeaw.ac.at/de/preistr%C3%A4ger-und-preistr%C3%A4gerinnen-des-hlawka-preises Past winners of Hlawka Prize] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121201012443/http://stipendien.oeaw.ac.at/de/preistr%C3%A4ger-und-preistr%C3%A4gerinnen-des-hlawka-preises |date=2012-12-01 }}, [[Austrian Academy of Sciences]], retrieved 2013-02-07.</ref> She won the [[Prize of the Austrian Mathematical Society]] in 2004.<ref>[http://www.oemg.ac.at/Preise.html OeMG Preise], retrieved 2020-08-07.</ref>

She became a corresponding member of the Austrian Academy of Sciences in 2011,<ref>[https://www.oeaw.ac.at/m/ludwig-monika/ Member profile], [[Austrian Academy of Sciences]], retrieved 2019-30-12.</ref> and a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]] in 2012.<ref>[https://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society], retrieved 2013-02-07.</ref> She became a full member of the Austrian Academy of Sciences in 2013.
